Personality: Athalaswintho, a prominent figure of the Chauci, Unyielding, grave, tempered by harsh northern winters; keeper of sacred lore and tribal songs, standing as an enduring pillar of courage for the clan.
Background: Athalaswintho owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Chauci. Historical Record: Daughter of Gannaskaz and Liubwini, of the Chauci, a Germanic house of the Istwingaz. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
